energy.initialization: OLS on measured power samples -20..30: B+Z exp(-(t+20)/30); equal sample loss, original baseline before35
energy.prediction: after35 B+(P35-B) exp(-(t-35)/30) plus unchanged state increments
energy.fixed_time_constant: prior hypothesis, not fitted physical constant
energy.unavailable: coverage/order/count/rank/nonpositive predicted baseline; no clipping or zero fill

ap.initialization: OLS pre curve R+A exp(-beta dt)+Hfirst convolution(beta,30,dt); first observed AP is no longer forced exact; last observed AP remains exact anchor
ap.unavailable: existing preload/bracket checks plus rank3/finite; no invented state

combined: no third fitting or selection; arithmetic composition diagnostic only
development: same nine, each old/history30/history180 block must be nonworse; not independent cross-validation because there is no population training
selection: energy block mean whole120 MAE nonworse; AP block mean trajectory MAE and mean session max nonworse; at least one strict improvement; epsilon1e-10 numeric only
evaluation: old confirmation6/history confirmation6/sustained8 kept separate; already seen posthoc; all rejected diagnostic candidates retained
prediction_modes: B archived forecast schedule, no new service or scheduler execution
purpose: reduce energy/AP prediction errors, not policy ranking
